propositions: Dual vocabulary 'success criteria/acceptance criteria' in reviewer prompts pools criteria and applies a single bar, creating noise in the rubrics and generated guidance
The phrase 'Success Criteria' must be renamed to 'Acceptance Criteria' throughout reviewer prompt files and the criteria routing index to eliminate terminology inconsistency
Standalone bare tokens 'SC' in plan_review_G3.md ('THREE SC-CONTRADICTION PATTERNS' and 'SC says zero matches') must be hand-renamed to use 'AC' prefix to avoid false-positives with 'O-RAN-SC'
The plan-review criteria guide is generated from these prompts and must be regenerated after the rename to remove all in-scope SC vocabulary references

Three sites must be explicitly preserved unchanged: plan_review_T2.md's generic trial success metrics phrase, and dod_uncertifiable wording in plan_review_verifier.md and plan_review_verifier_agentic.md
The criteria routing edit rotates the regver stamp, which is safe only after ADR 0053 grandfathering merged to avoid stranding ~40 in-flight plan-review attestations as stale-regver
